privacy_notice: This packet is generated locally and may contain personal account information, holdings, costs, cash, repo, trade plans, and manually entered evidence. Stock-Pilot does not send it to any external LLM, does not call deep analysis, and does not upload attachments automatically. External sharing happens only if the user actively copies, downloads, or submits the content elsewhere.
